author: musho7-dev
subject: Better shocks for every car: progressive bump stop + compression damping
body:
- landings no longer bottom out (wheels slamming into the body): 1.93 -> 0 hits per landing,
  fewer hops after landing (0.79 -> 0.17), same shaking on normal driving
- tools/landing_test.gd measures it for all cars

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
